  use GenServer

  @type pattern :: String.t()
  @type handler :: (Outbox.Eventing.Event.t() -> :ok | {:error, term()})
  @type opts :: keyword()

          handler: handler()

  def init(_nil) do
    ensure_ets_counters!()
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{}}

    id = Ash.ActionInput.get_argument(input, :subscriber_id)

defmodule Outbox.Eventing.Notifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Captures post-commit notifications from ledger resources and writes to the outbox.
  """

  use Ash.Notifier
  require Ash.Query

  @ledger_resources [Outbox.Ledger.Account, Outbox.Ledger.Transfer]

  @impl true
  def notify(notification) do
    unless notification.resource in @ledger_resources do
      :ok
    else
      if Keyword.get(notification.opts, :return_notifications?, false) do
        :ok
      else
        write_events(notification)
      end
    end
  end

  defp write_events(notification) do
    case notification.action_type do
      :create ->
        records = List.wrap(notification.data)
        Enum.each(records, fn record ->
          create_event(:create, notification.resource, record, record, notification.actor, notification.action.name)
        end)
      :update ->
        # Ash batch update notifications contain the updated records in data,
        # but not the pre-action record. So we can only record the "to" values.
        records = List.wrap(notification.data)
        Enum.each(records, fn record ->
          # public attributes that were set by the action
          changes = Map.new(notification.public_changes || [], fn attr ->
            {to_string(attr), %{"from" => nil, "to" => encode_val(Map.get(record, attr))}}
          end)
          create_event(:update, notification.resource, record, record, notification.actor, notification.action.name, changes)
        end)
      :destroy ->
        # no records left; the record's primary key is in record
        record = notification.record
        create_event(:destroy, notification.resource, record, %{id: record.id}, notification.actor, notification.action.name, %{})
      _ ->
        :ok
    end
  end

  defp create_event(action_type, resource, source_record, display_record, actor, action, changes \\ nil) do
    agg_type = aggregate_type(resource)
    agg_id = to_string(display_record.id)

    # ensure global counter and per-aggregate counter are correct even under concurrency
    seq = Outbox.Eventing.Dispatcher.next_global_sequence()
    agg_seq = Outbox.Eventing.Dispatcher.next_aggregate_sequence(agg_type, agg_id)

    topic = "ledger.#{agg_type}.#{action}"
    actor_id = actor && is_binary(Map.get(actor, :id)) && actor.id

    changes = changes || case action_type do
      :create ->
        # public, non-pk attributes with non-nil values, "from" => nil
        changeset = Ash.Changeset.new(resource, %{})
        public_attrs = Ash.Resource.Info.public_attributes(resource)
        pk = Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(resource)
        Map.new(for attr <- public_attrs, attr not in pk, val = Map.get(source_record, attr), !is_nil(val) do
          {to_string(attr.name), %{"from" => nil, "to" => encode_val(val)}}
        end)
      :update ->
        # attributes that actually differ between source_record and display_record
        # display_record is the result record (after), source_record is the before record
        public_attrs = Ash.Resource.Info.public_attributes(resource)
        pk = Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(resource)
        Map.new(for attr <- public_attrs, attr not in pk,
          before = Map.get(source_record, attr), after = Map.get(display_record, attr), before != after do
            {to_string(attr.name), %{"from" => encode_val(before), "to" => encode_val(after)}}
          end)
      :destroy -> %{}
    end

    dedup = "#{agg_type}:#{agg_id}:#{action}:#{agg_seq}"

    attrs = %{
      sequence: seq,
      aggregate_sequence: agg_seq,
      topic: topic,
      resource: resource |> inspect() |> String.replace_prefix("Elixir.", ""),
      aggregate_type: agg_type,
      aggregate_id: agg_id,
      action: action,
      actor_id: actor_id,
      changes: changes,
      dedup_key: dedup
    }

    Outbox.Eventing.Event |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:create, attrs) |> Outbox.Eventing.create!()
  end

  defp aggregate_type(resource) do
    resource |> inspect() |> String.split(".") |> List.last() |> Macro.underscore()
  end

  defp encode_val(val)
  defp encode_val(nil), do: nil
  defp encode_val(a) when is_atom(a), do: Atom.to_string(a)
  defp encode_val(v), do: v
end

defmodule Outbox.Eventing.Dispatcher do
  @moduledoc """
  A long-lived process that fans out outbox entries to registered subscribers.
  """

  @behaviour Ash.Action
  use GenServer

  @type subscriber_id :: atom()
  @type pattern :: String.t()
  @type handler :: (Outbox.Eventing.Event.t() -> :ok | {:error, term()})
  @type opts :: keyword()

  @type dead_letter :: %{
          subscriber_id: subscriber_id(),
          sequence: integer(),
          attempts: integer(),
          reason: term()
        }

  @typep pending_delivery :: %{
          subscriber_id: subscriber_id(),
          entry: Outbox.Eventing.Event.t(),
          attempts: integer(),
          delivery_mode: :sync | :async,
          handler: handler()
        }

  defstruct [register_order: [], subscribers: %{}, queue: [], dead_letters: []]

  @table_global :outbox_seq_global
  @table_aggregate :outbox_seq_aggregate
  @table_sync :outbox_sync_subscribers

  def start_link(_opts), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, nil, name: __MODULE__)

  @impl true
  def init(_nil) do
    ensure_ets_counters!()
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{}}
  end

  # API

  @spec subscribe(subscriber_id(), pattern(), handler(), opts()) :: :ok | {:error, :already_subscribed}
  def subscribe(id, pattern, handler, opts \\ []), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:subscribe, id, pattern, handler, opts})

  @spec unsubscribe(subscriber_id()) :: :ok
  def unsubscribe(id), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:unsubscribe, id})

  @spec flush() :: :ok
  def flush(), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :flush)

  @spec dead_letters() :: [dead_letter()]
  def dead_letters(), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :dead_letters)

  @spec reset() :: :ok
  def reset(), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :reset)

  @spec replay(integer(), subscriber_id()) :: [integer()]
  def replay(after_seq, id), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:replay, after_seq, id})

  @spec add_failed_delivery(subscriber_id(), Outbox.Eventing.Event.t(), integer(), term()) :: :ok
  def add_failed_delivery(id, entry, attempts, reason), do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:add_failed_delivery, id, entry, attempts, reason})

  @impl true
  def run(input, _opts, _context) do
    after_seq = Ash.ActionInput.get_argument(input, :after_sequence)
    id = Ash.ActionInput.get_argument(input, :subscriber_id)
    {:ok, replay(after_seq, id)}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:subscribe, id, pat, handler, opts}, _from, state) do
    if Map.has_key?(state.subscribers, id) do
      {:reply, {:error, :already_subscribed}, state}
    else
      mode = Keyword.get(opts, :mode, :async)
      sub = %{pattern: pat, handler: handler, mode: mode}
      new_subs = Map.put(state.subscribers, id, sub)
      new_order = state.register_order ++ [id]
      if mode == :sync do
        after_seq = get_global_sequence()
        :ets.insert(@table_sync, {id, pat, handler, after_seq})
      end
      {:reply, :ok, %{state | subscribers: new_subs, register_order: new_order}}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:unsubscribe, id}, _from, state) do
    new_subs = Map.delete(state.subscribers, id)
    new_order = List.delete(state.register_order, id)
    :ets.delete(@table_sync, id)
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | subscribers: new_subs, register_order: new_order}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:flush, _from, state) do
    # append async deliveries of newly-created events to the queue
    new_queue = state.queue
    last_processed = :ets.lookup_element(@table_global, :last_processed, 2) rescue _ -> 0
    events = Outbox.Eventing.Event |> Ash.Query.for_read(:read) |> Ash.Query.filter(sequence > ^last_processed) |> Ash.Query.sort(sequence: :asc) |> Outbox.Eventing.read!()
    for ev <- events do
      for {id, sub} <- Enum.sort_by(state.subscribers, fn {i, _} -> Enum.find_index(state.register_order, &(&1 == i)) end),
          sub.mode == :async and topic_matches?(ev.topic, sub.pattern) do
        new_queue = new_queue ++ [%{subscriber_id: id, entry: ev, attempts: 0, delivery_mode: :async, handler: sub.handler}]
      end
      :ets.insert(@table_global, {:last_processed, ev.sequence})
    end
    {:reply, :ok, drain(%{state | queue: new_queue})}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:dead_letters, _from, state) do
    {:reply, Enum.sort_by(state.dead_letters, fn dl -> {dl.sequence, Enum.find_index(state.register_order, &(&1 == dl.subscriber_id))} end), state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:reset, _from, state) do
    reset_counters!()
    :ets.delete_all_objects(@table_sync)
    Outbox.Eventing.Event |> Ash.Query.for_read(:read) |> Outbox.Eventing.read!() |> Enum.each(&Outbox.Eventing.destroy!(&1))
    {:reply, :ok, %__MODULE__{}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:replay, after_seq, id}, _from, state) do
    sub = Map.get(state.subscribers, id)
    if !sub do
